Macrons

Consonantal i

Tools, fasteners & household repair

trowel noun

also mason’s trowel, plasterer’s trowel

post-classical

Traupman 168
Smith & Hall s.v. trowel
Pall. 1.13.2; 1.15

trulla, trullae f.

noun, first declension

mason’s or plasterer’s trowel

Ancient building use in Palladius. In the kitchen the same word is a ladle.

Examples

  • Trullā tēctōrium aequā.

    Level the plaster with the trowel.composed

See also notched trowel, spatula, skimming blade, ladle.

SourcesTraupman: Conversational Latin (printed page references in entry) · Lewis & Short: trulla · Palladius, Opus agriculturae 1.13.2 and 1.15 · Morgan–Owens: trowel · Smith & Hall: trowel

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
